LanguageData.BOR_Neutronium.label: neutronium
LanguageData.BOR_Neutronium.description: An exotic form of matter composed of neutrons in tight gridlock. While naturally-occuring neutronium maintains this density through its own gravity, one must commit massive quantities of energy in order to form and maintain neutron matter planetside. It occurs naturally in deep subsurface deposits across the rim, though its unique composition makes it completely undetectable without the right technology - most colonies sit atop vast reserves without ever knowing. Once you have the means to find and extract it, however, it is remarkably abundant. On its own it is useless to you and dangerous to store, but alongside solar, quasar, and tenebral tech it can be used to transmute elements, synthesize goods, and equip armies. You can form neutronium into virtually anything!
LanguageData.BOR_Sunsteel.label: sunsteel
LanguageData.BOR_Sunsteel.description: An enhanced form of plasteel, saturated with superheavy nucleic matter. Plasteel's iconic molecular structure keeps these massive atoms from falling apart through the sheer strength of its bonds. Sunsteel is a strong material used to construct buildings and craft weapons on par with the Solar Republics in terms of power and durability.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunweave.label: sunweave
LanguageData.BOR_Sunweave.description: Nano-fibers woven into sheets molecule-by-molecule using specialized production mechanites. While similarly flexible to most textiles, it hardens in response to physical trauma and is otherwise incredibly difficult to destroy. The secrets of its production are guarded religiously by Solar Republics.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarAlloy.label: quasar alloy
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarAlloy.description:
A borderline Archeotech material originally synthesized within the exotic environment of a supermassive black-hole, Quasar Alloy is considered to be a composite alloy substrate with nucleic material nodes.
Those without degrees in Speculative Physics and Material Sciences often call Quasar Alloy: "Basically f*@king indestructible"
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarAlloyWeave.label: quasarite weave
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarAlloyWeave.description: Pico-fibers of Quasar Alloy ornately woven into squares of fabric quark-by-quark using proprietary manipulation techniques unshared by the Kwazaari peoples. An incredibly flexible material which is capable of hardening in response to physical trauma to such a degree not even mono-molecular blades may puncture its weave. The secrets of its production are kept a secret by any and all Kwazaari cultures, often through violence or cutthroat 'sales acquisitions'.
LanguageData.BOR_ComponentII.label: kwazaari universal part
LanguageData.BOR_ComponentII.description: A mass-produced and highly configurable piece of machinery used for most quasar technology.
